name: Researcher-with-source-acquisition → Reviewer Handoff
description: When the source-acquisition retry researcher loop completes successfully, spawn a research-reviewer to evaluate the (potentially substrate-extended) artifact. Sibling to rule 01a — separate file because the rule engine matches role with eq, not in, so the two roles each need their own rule. R2.5 of the ADR-031 phasing.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.research-review
on_enter.prompt: Evaluate the prior researcher-with-source-acquisition loop's submission. Researcher loop id: $entity.id. Call read_loop_result with that loop id to fetch the artifact, apply the active checklist, then call decide(action="approved") if all required items are present, or decide(action="insufficient", reason="<bullet list of gaps>") otherwise.
